page: Amazon Web Services c7g.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the custom AWS Graviton3 processor family. Built on the 64-bit ARM architecture, specifically the ARMv8 Neoverse-V1 platform, this server features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs running at 2.6 GHz with no hyperthreading. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. The processor includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. It does not feature local NVMe storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the c7g.2xlarge in the average performance tier for most standard compute workloads. In stress-ng testing, it achieved a single-core score of 1532.98 and a multi-core score of 12238.41. Memory performance is supported by a cached read bandwidth of 774.89 GB/sec and an uncached large-block read bandwidth of 146.42 GB/sec. The instance demonstrates solid capabilities in web serving, with a static web serving throughput of 15.45 GB/sec, and database operations, processing 13.27 million Redis SET operations per second. However, it shows weaker performance in specific areas, such as bzip3 decompression and Passmark encryption tests. Large language model inference is also limited, particularly for prompt processing on 7B models, which registered at a poor 14.13 tokens per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture delivers competitive compute density and lower power consumption compared to traditional x86 alternatives, translating to a favorable qualitative cost-to-performance ratio for compatible workloads. The c7g.2xlarge is well-suited for compute-intensive applications that scale across dedicated cores, such as web serving, software compilation, and distributed database nodes. It is less optimal for workloads requiring local high-speed SSD storage, heavy cryptographic operations, or large-scale machine learning inference.
description: Amazon Web Services c7g.2xlarge is an ARM64 compute-optimized instance powered by an 8-core AWS Graviton3 processor running at 2.6 GHz. It features 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core, and operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The instance lacks local storage and dedicated GPUs, relying on a 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark data shows average performance across standard compute tasks, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 8116.0 and a static web serving throughput of 15.45 GB/sec. It also handles database workloads efficiently, delivering 13.27 million Redis SET operations per second. However, it exhibits weaker performance in cryptographic tasks and large language model prompt processing. This instance is best suited for scale-out compute workloads, software compilation, and web serving where ARM architecture compatibility is met.
